_comment: Archive retention policies per domain. New domains registered via Streamlit app or CLI will inherit 'default' until explicitly configured.
_note: hot_retention_days = how long data stays in staging before archival. archive_duration_days = how long archived data is kept.

default.rationale: Default for any domain not explicitly listed

ers.rationale: High volume — data propagates to datalake same day

claims.rationale: Claims can be reopened up to 90 days post-processing

travel.rationale: Fast propagation — staging data has no value after 7 days
